description: Open-source inference platform for language, vision, embedding, reranking, image, audio, and video models. Deploy with multiple engines across heterogeneous hardware, from a laptop to a distributed cluster. Serve models through OpenAI-compatible APIs.
summary: Swap GPT for any LLM by changing a single line of code. Xinference lets you run open-source, speech, and multimodal models on cloud, on-prem, or your laptop — all through one unified, production-ready inference API.
